K.rationale: Passes RUN in the pool. The key defines the symbol; this is the column.

architecture.rationale: single-pass / consensus / proposer-verifier — the evaluable architecture.

blocked_reason.rationale: Why a blocked job cannot run; never a placeholder, always a measured fact.

bounds_path.rationale: The evaluation bounds defining the frame.

buffer_m.rationale: Third component, as an integer column; `R_m` is the corrected-F1 CSV's name.

ci_method.rationale: The CI method the source evaluation recorded; omitted where it recorded none.

ci_unreliable.rationale: The measured D28/E72 reliability verdict carried through from the source.

command.rationale: The exact invocation the operator runs on sapphire.

condition_id.rationale: The `run_id::label` composite spelled as a column name.

corpus.rationale: First component of stratum_id: 4-map-gs or 55-map, from run-facts.json.

cost_basis.rationale: Which cost basis `cost_usd` carries; NOT the audited basis (see build report).

crop_manifest_path.rationale: The candidate manifest of the cell's own proposer pool, when the twin is the vote shell of the universe its verifier cropped (pairing_basis crop-manifest).

delta.rationale: target_value - source_value; a transfer tax when the sign is negative.

engine.rationale: Which scorer the job needs: evaluate_detections or corrected_f1_multi_buffer.

eval_path.rationale: The evaluation artefact the metrics came from.

frame_id.rationale: Fourth component: the evaluation frame id (era-1-340, era-2-487, ...).

geometry.rationale: The geometry cell label the key defines, as a column.

geometry_basis.rationale: Which rule resolved the geometry: pool-name, label, or run-facts-tile-size.

headline_reference.rationale: True where the stratum's reference is the corpus headline reference (r2 on the 55-map corpus, curator on the gold standard; PI ruling 2026-09-10).

is_primary_buffer.rationale: True where buffer_m is the corpus headline buffer (20 m GS / 50 m 55-map).

job_id.rationale: Primary key of a scoring job in a worklist.

k1_with_verifier.rationale: derivable / blocked / not-applicable — the card's disclosed K = 1 PV anchor.

k1_with_verifier_reason.rationale: The measured ground for that verdict; never an approximation.

materialise_command.rationale: Prelude that builds the twin with the source_tile the engine scopes by.

materialise_filter.rationale: The vote_count predicate that turns the union into the paired shell.

mde_50.rationale: Minimum detectable effect at 50 % power, joined from sensitivity.json.

mde_80.rationale: Minimum detectable effect at 80 % power, joined from sensitivity.json.

mde_instrument.rationale: The named permutation instrument the MDE and null SD describe.

mde_join_basis.rationale: The join key used (n_tiles + buffer_m) and any ambiguity it carries.

mde_source.rationale: The artefact the instrument's null SD was measured from.

metric.rationale: Which metric the delta is on (F1, MCC, precision, recall).

metrics_source.rationale: conditions-manifest or evaluation-json — where this row's metrics were read.

modality.rationale: Proposer input modality; the key names the values, not a column.

model_used.rationale: Authoritative model identity, read from per-item metadata, never a name.

n_comparisons.rationale: Pairwise comparisons the instrument's null SD was measured over.

n_conditions.rationale: How many registered conditions resolve into the stratum.

n_refs.rationale: Reference mounds in the stratum's reference file; the key gives no column name.

notes.rationale: Free text recording any gap or caveat attached to this row.

null_sd_hi.rationale: High end of the instrument's observed null-SD range.

null_sd_lo.rationale: Low end of the instrument's observed null-SD range.

output_dir.rationale: Where the job writes its evaluation.

overlap_px.rationale: Overlap in pixels, the second half of the geometry cell.

pair_id.rationale: Primary key of a transfer pair; the key defines the object, not the column.

pairing_basis.rationale: Which rule located the pre-verifier twin: registered, consensus-file, union, crop-manifest.

proposer_pool.rationale: The pool component of the pass id, as a column.

rationale.rationale: Why this pair is a meaningful comparison despite spanning strata.

reference.rationale: Second component: curator / student / canonical / standardised.

reference_basis.rationale: Which rule resolved `reference`: eval-ground-truth, label-suffix, or run-facts.

reference_consumed_path.rationale: The path the evaluation literally recorded, where it differs from the anchor.

reference_path.rationale: The ground-truth GeoJSON the evaluation consumed (the re-verify anchor).

registered_analysis_id.rationale: The registered analysis this pair belongs to, where one exists.

run_id.rationale: Foreign key to the run registry; the key names the composite, not the part.

rung.rationale: Which ladder rung the job scores (N = 1 for the K = 1 gap-fill).

source_condition.rationale: The K >= 3 consensus cell whose K = 1 rung this job supplies.

source_condition_id.rationale: The cell a calibration or claim came FROM.

source_stratum_id.rationale: Its stratum — necessarily different from the target's.

source_value.rationale: The metric's value in the source cell.

status.rationale: ready / blocked / already-registered — whether the job can run at all.

stride_px.rationale: tile_px - overlap_px, which the key defines as the stride.

target_condition_id.rationale: The cell the claim was carried TO.

target_stratum_id.rationale: The target cell's stratum; the delta is a transfer across the two.

target_value.rationale: The metric's value in the target cell.

tax_kind.rationale: Which tax the pair isolates: geometry, reference, corpus, buffer, or frame.

temperature.rationale: Sampling temperature. `T` alone is too short to be a safe CSV header.

thinking.rationale: Thinking level; the key names the levels, not a column.

tile_px.rationale: Tile size in pixels, the first half of the geometry cell.

transfer.rationale: Always TRUE here: the flag that licenses a cross-stratum number.

union_path.rationale: The committed vote >= 1 union the vote shell must be filtered out of.

unverified_condition_id.rationale: The registered pre-verifier cell, where one already exists.

unverified_detections_path.rationale: The pre-verifier consensus set at the same vote threshold.

unverified_eval_path.rationale: That cell's committed evaluation, where one already exists.

unverified_stratum_basis.rationale: Whether the twin's stratum was derived from its own cell or from the recipe.

unverified_stratum_id.rationale: The twin's stratum, keyed independently; a tripwire, not a lineage check.

unverified_value.rationale: The paired unverified cell's metric value.

uplift.rationale: verified minus unverified on the same metric, same stratum.

uplift_metric.rationale: Which metric the uplift column is computed on.

verified.rationale: Boolean: a verifier stage ran. The key names the architecture, not a flag.

verified_condition_id.rationale: The verified cell of a with/without-verifier pair.

verified_stratum_id.rationale: The verified cell's own stratum, keyed from its own evidence.

verifier_crop_manifest.rationale: The candidate manifest that measurement came from.

verifier_floor_basis.rationale: How the cell's verifier stage was matched: lineage, shell, sole, or ambiguous.

verifier_min_vote_seen.rationale: Lowest vote_count the verifier actually saw, measured from the crop manifest.

verifier_variant.rationale: Verifier variant id from the condition's verifier_config.
